text:
Situation: Azacitidine has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-12-18 and remains current as of 2026-10-21, a span of 70 months. Current inventory across three Corvale sites totals 185.67 units with days-on-hand ranging from 9 to 19.8 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2020-12-18. A registered plant for Accord Healthcare's product, Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473), received an OAI classification on 2022-12-02. FDA issued import alert 66-40 for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited on 2023-06-01 and again on 2023-11-14, and warning letters on 2023-07-28 and 2023-11-21 for two Intas sites.

Our position: Supply is constrained and variable across sites. P&T-approved interchange options exist for Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (approved 2026-04-04) and Accord Healthcare Inc. (approved 2025-09-24). BluePoint Laboratories is not on FDA's shortage list today and its plant, Sindan-Pharma Srl, had an NAI inspection on 2024-08-02.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories; requires buyer approval.
2. Pharmacist to substitute Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. product per P&T approval dated 2026-04-04; requires pharmacist approval.
3. Pharmacist to substitute Accord Healthcare Inc. product per P&T approval dated 2025-09-24; requires pharmacist approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC and Apotex Corp as additional sources; requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending resolution of the long-standing shortage.
